# The camera reference check boxes (412 model, 531 bone) and
# ApplyCameraReferenceModeChange (frame_modes.cpp) in model mode, then the
# same boxes in camera mode, where the view does not move.
load model chain8.pmx
select bone 首
bone position 0 0.5 0
camera reference 1
save pmm model-root.pmm
camera reference 2
save pmm selected-bone.pmm
camera reference 0
save pmm none.pmm

select camera
camera reference 2
save pmm camera-mode.pmm
